prompts.station: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW original panoramic pixel-art 2D fighting game background. Reference image is STYLE ONLY: match its crisp detailed pixel clusters, arcade anime environment art, lighting richness and perspective scale, but create a different location. Wide 8:3 composition, one continuous asymmetric scene, no mirroring or repeated tiles. Foreground from 72% to 100% image height is a level unobstructed fighting floor across the ENTIRE width, with feet standing at 85% image height. Ground must continue to bottom edge, no platform underside visible. Background architecture stays behind fighting strip. Side-view camera, rich depth behind level floor, no fighters, no UI, no text captions, no watermark. Rainy midnight elevated railway station. Indigo and teal night with warm amber waiting-room windows, distant city towers, a stationary train behind the platform, canopy steel beams, vending-machine glow, wet tiles and puddle reflections. Unique left ticket booth and right stairs. Full-width safe platform paving in foreground; tracks only behind it.
